description: Final checks for VOPP1 Q96AW1: (1) position of the YxxPhi tyrosine relative to the C-terminus compared with validated lysosomal YxxPhi sorting signals; (2) paralog / domain-family check for the VOPP1_N lumenal domain to assess over-annotation risk; (3) write evidence matrix and GO decision table artifacts to provenance/.

       "DPGGPGMNPVGNSMAMAFQVPPNSPQGSVACPPPPAYCNTPPPPYEQVVKAK")

# TEST 1: spacing of the YxxPhi tyrosine from the C-terminus
# Benchmark = validated C-terminal tyrosine-based lysosomal sorting signals
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
bench = {
 "P11279":"LAMP1","P13473":"LAMP2","P08962":"CD63","Q14108":"SCARB2/LIMP2",
 "P16870":"CPE_ctrl_noYxxPhi","Q13571":"LAPTM5","Q9BW60":"ELOVL1_ctrl",
 "P27105":"STOM_ctrl","Q9H9H4":"VPS37B_ctrl","O43657":"TSPAN6_ctrl",
 "P05556":"ITGB1","P04233":"CD74","P30530":"AXL_ctrl","Q9UBG0":"MRC2",
 "P08571":"CD14_ctrl","Q96AW1":"VOPP1","Q9NUM4":"TMEM106B","Q8WW34":"TMEM239_ctrl",
}
seqs={}
for acc in bench:
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60)
    if r.status_code==200:
        s="".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
        seqs[acc]=s
print("fetched",len(seqs),"benchmark sequences")

PHI="LIVMF"
rows=[]
for acc,name in bench.items():
    s=seqs.get(acc)
    if not s: 
        rows.append(dict(acc=acc,name=name,len=None,note="fetch failed")); continue
    # last YxxPhi in the sequence
    hits=[(m.start()+1,m.group()) for m in re.finditer(r'(?=(Y..['+PHI+']))',s)]
    hits=[(p,re.match(r'Y..['+PHI+']',s[p-1:p+3]).group()) for p,_ in hits]
    last=[h for h in hits if len(s)-h[0] <= 30]
    best = last[-1] if last else None
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc,name=name,len=len(s),
                     n_YxxPhi_total=len(hits),
                     last_YxxPhi=best[1] if best else "",
                     Y_pos=best[0] if best else np.nan,
                     res_after_Y=(len(s)-best[0]) if best else np.nan,
                     cterm12=s[-12:]))
bench_df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(bench_df[["acc","name","len","last_YxxPhi","Y_pos","res_after_Y","cterm12"]].to_string(index=False))

known = bench_df[bench_df.name.isin(["LAMP1","LAMP2","CD63","SCARB2/LIMP2","CD74","ITGB1","MRC2","TMEM106B"])]
print("\nValidated/annotated tyrosine-signal proteins: residues after Y =",
      sorted(known.res_after_Y.dropna().astype(int).tolist()))
v=bench_df.loc[bench_df.name=="VOPP1","res_after_Y"].iloc[0]
print("VOPP1 residues after Y165 =",int(v))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# TEST 2: paralog / family check (over-annotation risk)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
para={}
for q,label in [("(xref:interpro-IPR060429)","IPR060429 VOPP1_N"),
                ("(xref:pfam-PF27964)","PF27964"),
                ("(gene:VOPP1)+AND+(reviewed:true)","gene VOPP1 reviewed")]:
    url=f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query={q}&format=json&size=100&fields=accession,id,organism_name,protein_name,length"
    r=requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=120)
    if r.status_code!=200:
        para[label]=f"HTTP {r.status_code}"; print(label,"->",para[label]); continue
    j=r.json().get("results",[])
    para[label]=len(j)
    print(f"\n{label}: {len(j)} entries")
    for e in j[:12]:
        print("   ",e["primaryAccession"], e.get("organism",{}).get("scientificName",""), e.get("sequence",{}).get("length",""))

# human-only members of the family
url=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=(xref:interpro-IPR060429)+AND+(organism_id:9606)"
     "&format=json&size=50&fields=accession,id,protein_name,length")
r=requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=120)
human_fam=r.json().get("results",[]) if r.status_code==200 else []
print("\nHuman proteins with IPR060429:",len(human_fam),[e["primaryAccession"] for e in human_fam])
